table.title: Table
table.description: A flexible table component for displaying structured data with sorting and pagination support.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import the Table component from the shared components library.

howToUse.title: How to use
howToUse.description: Use the Table component by providing columns, data, and the required pagination metadata.

definition.title: Definition
definition.description: Define your table data and columns, then pass them to the Table component.
definition.howToUseDescription: Define the data rows and column configuration, then pass them using the value and columns props.

pagination.title: Offset Pagination
pagination.description: Use standard pagination when your API returns page-based metadata such as the current page, total pages, and total items.

cursorPagination.title: Cursor Pagination
cursorPagination.description: Use cursor pagination when your API uses cursors to navigate between result sets instead of page numbers.

props.title: Props
props.description: The Table component accepts the following props to control its data, appearance, and pagination behavior.
props.name: Prop
props.columns: Defines the columns displayed in the table.
props.value: The data rows displayed in the table.
props.loading: Displays a loading state while the table data is being loaded.
props.meta: Provides pagination metadata for standard or cursor-based pagination.
props.limitOptions: Defines the available options for the number of rows displayed per page.
props.clickable: Makes table rows clickable and enables the rowClick event.
props.isFilteredEmpty: Displays the filtered empty state when filtering returns no results.
props.isSearchEmpty: Displays the search empty state when searching returns no results.

events.title: Events
events.description: The Table component emits events when the user interacts with sorting, pagination, or table rows.
events.name: Event
events.sort: Emitted when the user changes the sorting of a column.
events.pageChange: Emitted when the user changes the current page.
events.limitChange: Emitted when the user changes the number of rows displayed per page.
events.next: Emitted when the user requests the next set of data.
events.prev: Emitted when the user requests the previous set of data.
events.rowClick: Emitted when the user clicks a table row and provides the clicked row as the payload.
